case_name: SaaS site missing meta + social tags

fixes.fix_code: <meta name="description" content="Acme SaaS is a project management platform designed for growing teams. Streamline workflows, boost collaboration, and deliver projects on time.">
fixes.fix_explanation: Add a meta description tag that summarizes your page content in 120-160 characters. This text appears in search results and improves click-through rates.

fixes.fix_code: <meta property="og:title" content="Acme SaaS — Project Management for Growing Teams">
fixes.fix_explanation: Add Open Graph title meta tag so your page displays with a proper title when shared on social media platforms like Facebook and LinkedIn.

fixes.fix_code: <meta property="og:description" content="Streamline team collaboration and project delivery with Acme SaaS. Powerful project management tools built for growing teams.">
fixes.fix_explanation: Add Open Graph description that displays when your page is shared socially. Keep it engaging and concise to encourage clicks.
Add an Open Graph image (1200x630px recommended) that appears when your page is shared on social platforms. Ensure the image file exists at this URL.

fixes.fix_code: <meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image"><meta name="twitter:title" content="Acme SaaS — Project Management for Growing Teams"><meta name="twitter:description" content="Streamline team collaboration and project delivery with Acme SaaS. Powerful project management tools built for growing teams."><meta name="twitter:image" content="https://acme-saas.com/og-image.png">
fixes.fix_explanation: Add Twitter Card meta tags so your page displays with rich formatting when shared on Twitter/X, including title, description, and image.
